## ✅ Deliverables Pertemuan Ini

### 📄 Dokumen & Artefak

- [ ] Activity Diagram
- [ ] Use Case Diagram
- [ ] Class Diagram
- [ ] Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD)
- [ ] Data Dictionary
- [ ] Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
- [ ] User Stories & Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Product Backlog
- [ ] Test Cases
- [ ] Problem Statement
- [ ] retrospective
- [ ] team-contract
- [ ] test case
- [ ] wireframe

### 💻 Implementasi Kode

- [ ] README.md final yang lengkap dan informatif
- [ ] File `CHANGELOG.md` berisi catatan perubahan versi 1.0.0
- [ ] Release tag v1.0.0 di GitHub
- [ ] `docs/ai-usage-log.md` (jika penggunaan AI signifikan)
- [ ] Slide presentasi demo tersimpan di `docs/presentation/`

### 🧪 Testing

- [ ] Unit Test selesai dijalankan
- [ ] Semua test lulus (passing)
- [ ] Bug yang ditemukan dicatat
